modern: Look deep into men’s leading principles, and you will see what judges you are afraid of, and what kind of judges they are of themselves.
original: Penetrate inwards into men’s leading principles, and thou wilt see what judges thou art afraid of, and what kind of judges they are of themselves.
notification: Look deep into men’s leading principles, and you will see what judges you are afraid of, and what kind of judges they are of themselves.
notification_original: Penetrate inwards into men’s leading principles, and thou wilt see what judges thou art afraid of, and what kind of judges they are of themselves.

explained.summary: Look closely at what really drives the people whose opinions you fear. You’ll see what sort of judges they are, and how poorly they judge even themselves. Their verdict on you will start to seem far less worth worrying about.
explained.today: The people whose comments you dread online, or whose approval you chase at work, are often just as muddled and anxious as anyone. Seeing that clearly takes the sting out of their judgement.
